info.title: Turbo Notify Public API
info.description: Turbo Notify Public API for WhatsApp messaging. All message, contact, and group operations are nested under `/v1/numbers/{alias}/...` so the inbox number (the reserved `main` alias or an extra-number alias) is identified by the URL rather than a request-body `from` field. Account-wide resources (usage, events, numbers lifecycle) remain flat.

get.description:
Readiness check with dependency verification.

Runs all registered health checkers and returns 503 if any
critical dependency is unhealthy.
List messages for the inbox identified by `alias` (cursor-paginated, newest first).

post.description: Send a message from the number identified by `alias` (`main` or an extra alias). The sender is taken from the URL — there is no request-body `from` field.

get.description: Retrieve the full details of a message by its public `msg_{hex32}` id, scoped to the inbox identified by `alias`.
Get delivery status for a sent message by its public `msg_{hex32}` id, scoped to the inbox identified by `alias`.
List all active reactions to a message.
List delivery receipt history for a message (status transitions, ascending).

post.description: Reply to a message from the number identified by `alias`. The recipient is inferred from the quoted message direction; there is no request-body `from` field. Returns 202 Accepted; the result is delivered via webhook (`message.replied`).
Add or remove a reaction from the number identified by `alias`. Returns 202 Accepted; the result is delivered via webhook (`message.reacted`).
Edit a previously sent message by its public `msg_{hex32}` id. Returns 202 Accepted; the result is delivered via webhook (`message.edited`).
Delete (revoke) a previously sent message by its public `msg_{hex32}` id. Returns 202 Accepted; the result is delivered via webhook (`message.deleted`).
Send a typing indicator from the number identified by `alias`. The sender is inferred from the URL; there is no request-body `from` field.

get.description: Return a cursor-paginated list of contacts for the inbox `{alias}`.
Return the contact quota state for the inbox identified by `{alias}`.
Retrieve a single contact, asserting it belongs to inbox `{alias}`.
Resolve the contact's profile picture, asserting ownership by `{alias}`. Returns 302 redirect to a presigned URL when available, or 200 with an unavailable payload.

post.description: Queue a WhatsApp metadata refresh for a contact in inbox `{alias}`.

get.description: Return a cursor-paginated list of groups for the inbox `{alias}`.
Retrieve a single group for the inbox `{alias}`.
Resolve the group's profile picture for inbox `{alias}`. Returns 302 redirect to a presigned URL when available, or 200 with an unavailable payload.
Account-wide usage snapshot — message quota and contact quota.
Account-wide message quota snapshot (contact section stripped).

Account-wide event polling (Stripe-like). Optionally filter by `number_alias` to restrict results to a specific inbox; organization-scoped events without a `number_alias` (e.g. `storage.*`, `message.quota.*`) are excluded when that filter is active.

parameters.name: number_alias
parameters.description: Filter by inbox handle (`main` or extra alias). ADR 2026-06-22: restricts results to events belonging to this specific number. Organization-scoped events without a `number_alias` (e.g. `storage.*`, `message.quota.*`) are excluded when this filter is active.

post.description: Create (add) an extra number, then trigger pairing via `POST /v1/numbers/{alias}/pair`.

delete.description: Delete (schedule deletion of) an extra number. If eligible for a 72h refund, deletion is immediate.
